character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Anatomy: Imposing humanoid with crimson scales on the shoulders, throat, and forearms. Giant ash-black membranous wings and twisted, obsidian-like horns. Glowing yellow eyes that emit smoke.

Attire and Weapons: Heavy wrought-iron plate armor etched with glowing runes. Wields a massive greatsword from which hot magma flows.

Visual Style: High-contrast cinematic lighting (chiaroscuro), dynamic fire, hyper-detailed scales, dark fantasy anime aesthetic.
